coordinator_prior.statement: Equal-weight/no-overflow constraints can create common holes, so a better mean is unlikely to establish uniform coverage by itself. Even a finite mixture gain may fail the independent-endpoint or total-cost interface. These are design priors, not observations.

joints.claim: Source/target DP, count certificates, rank bijection and carry identity including formal semantic fidelity.
joints.attack: Independently reconstruct literal small-domain counts and a separate target recurrence, check every primary normalization certificate and structured target, inspect Lean quantifiers/endpoints/axioms and compare the formal statement with the frozen human lemma; do not accept compilation alone. Verify the no-carry subset/half-partition bijection and count identity on every even-w cell.

joints.claim: Training/holdout separation, exact tails, null fit and source formula correspondence.
joints.attack: Recompute optimizer tie decisions from archived training-only inputs, check actual policy seal/launch hash boundary, independently recompute held-out scores/permutation rank and zero handling; rebuild IID transition from definitions and read the cited primary source section without inheriting its output formula as a theorem.

joints.claim: Normalization, renewal cost, source size and solver-composition ceiling.
joints.attack: From only the statement packet derive joint source q, expected work to hit fixed x and conservative generator/table bounds. Construct the known non-product 2x2 source and identify the missing independent-endpoint law; price exponential certification/advice and compare output-only versus witness/solver access. Independently derive the pure no-carry source distribution and quantile-mass ceiling; determine whether a claimed2x gain could survive its required draw-cost condition.

joints.claim: Blind derivation of carry count, IID stationary marginal and contiguous-target coverage boundary.
joints.attack: From only bit definitions and parameter conventions derive the unweighted carry identity, two-state recurrence and stationary output rate, and solve equal-weight representations of x=2^w-1. Report scope for no-overflow versus modulo addition without reading producer formulas or advice.

blind_rederivation.quantity: Normalized useful-output probability, renewal draw cost, carry count identity, finite and stationary IID output-bit law, and equal-weight low-contiguous-ones target coverage. blind_from: formal proof and all sibling review content
blind_rederivation.packet_contract: Definitions only: m,w,U; ordinary addition endpoints; bit recurrence; S described by weight/carry positions/max-run conditions without the derived carry/weight identity; explicit weighted-stratum draw algorithm without its q formula; primitive charge schedule without renewal answer; IID Bernoulli bit model; target x=2^w-1; requests to derive the listed quantities. Exclude outputs, proposed formulas, expected answers, source-paper formula, priors, verdicts and all fit/run results. The snapshot owner checks this allowlist before release. Include a definition-only request about even-w uniform w-subsets followed by equal half-partitions, and the r-th ascending order statistic of an arbitrary N-point probability law. Do not disclose their resulting distribution, count formula or bound.
blind_rederivation.blindness_lift: None in this round. Coordinator compares the returned derivation with producer artifacts after both reports are archived; a necessary unblinding requires a separately declared hardening round.
